cells.reason: Paraguay Decree 1335/2019 incorporates MERCOSUR/GMC Resolution 12/11; the Annex Part II arsenic table sets total As 1 mg/kg for 'raw, frozen, or refrigerated fish', applied to the edible portion of the product as offered to the consumer, which is exactly fresh or frozen fillet on an as-consumed basis (no conversion). The decree has been in force since 20 February 2019 (status active). No stricter non-gated same-basis tAs row on fish exists (SG 1000 equal, MERCOSUR 1000 equal, AU-NZ 2000; GY 200 quarantined).

'Raw, frozen, or refrigerated fish' carries no species carve-out in the Paraguay/MERCOSUR arsenic table, so fresh or frozen tuna, swordfish, shark, king mackerel, marlin and other billfish are covered at 1 mg/kg edible portion. In force since 2019-02-20; the as-offered-to-consumer basis matches the as-consumed cell. No same-basis non-gated tAs row on any of these species is stricter than 1000 (SG and MERCOSUR 1000 equal, AU-NZ fish 2000).
